name: Cloudflare Sandbox
summary: Cloudflare Sandbox SDK runs untrusted or generated code in Linux containers that a Worker controls through a Durable Object, one sandbox per user, task or session. Each Container instance is a microVM with its own kernel and network, and outbound requests can be handled in Worker code so credentials stay outside the sandbox. It requires the Workers Paid plan.
facts: Container instances run as microVMs with their own kernel
Workers Paid ($5/month) with included usage; CPU billed on active use
GA since April 2026; SDK 1.0 released Sept 2026
goodFor: Apps already built on Workers and Durable Objects
Per-user or per-session sandboxes close to users
Keeping secrets in the Worker rather than the sandbox
watchOut: Not available on the Workers Free plan
Memory and disk billed on provisioned size while running
Legacy Sandbox class supported only through 2026-12-31
